text:
Based on the symptoms described, Mark is likely suffering from cholelithiasis (gallstones) or a related biliary obstruction. The severe abdominal pain worsening after high-fat meals is a classic sign of gallbladder issues, as fat stimulates the release of cholecystokinin, causing the gallbladder to contract against a blockage. The lighter-colored stool (acholic stool) and unusual itching (pruritus) indicate jaundice and the buildup of bile salts in the blood, suggesting that a stone may be obstructing the common bile duct, preventing bile from reaching the intestines.

The shape with three sides is a triangle.
